name: Kingston's Camp
description_short: A small, independently run, all-outdoor, unplugged day camp in West Kingston, RI for ages 4 to 14, with daily swim lessons, boating, arts and crafts and field games. The Main Program serves entering K-6th grade; the Middle School Gopher Program (grades 7-9) is a leadership program. Weekly sessions, 9am to 3pm.

refund_policy_summary: $30 annual registration fee and $30/week deposit are non-refundable; program fees fully refundable until June 1; no refunds for missed days, weather closures, pond closures or withdrawal.
special_needs_notes: Welcomes campers who can thrive in a group-based, active environment; reasonable accommodations offered when possible; families are asked to contact the camp before registering.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming in Larkin's Pond (a natural pond monitored for bacteria; occasionally closed). Daily swim lessons, shallow and deep areas, swim competency test before deep water, lifeguard-supervised waterfront.
